digest.en: U.K. PM Burnham names Reynolds as Business Minister, Rayner for housing, while Russian attacks kill six in Kyiv and other cities, exposing gaps in Ukraine's air defences. Central Asian Countries face fuel shortages as Russian oil exports drop off. China's mega-oiler could break America's Pacific base edge.

articles.title: U.K. PM Burnham names Reynolds as Business Minister, Rayner for housing
articles.summary: Jonathan Reynolds was named ‌Secretary ⁠of State for ⁠Business, Innovation, Science and Trade in an expanded role ​after losing his ‌position as business Minister to Peter Kyle in a reshuffle under ‌former Prime Minister ​Keir Starmer U. K. PM Burnham names Reynolds as Business Minister, Rayner for housing.

articles.title: Chomp Chomp's Ah Hock Fried Hokkien Noodles hawker dies aged 79
articles.summary: Second-generation hawker Ng Hock Chuan was the son of one of Singapore’s Hokkien mee pioneers. He spent decades behind the wok at Chomp Chomp Food Centre, where the family stall has operated since the 1970s. Chomp Chomp's Ah Hock Fried Hokkien Noodles hawker dies aged 79.

articles.title: How the horror film Obsession turns the anxieties of modern dating into something terrifying
articles.summary: The horror hit Obsession isn't just about an obsessive girlfriend or an entitled "nice guy", says this writer. It's also a chilling reflection of how dating today has made many of us crave certainty, shortcuts and imagined intimacy. Minor spoilers ahead. How the horror film Obsession turns the anxieties of modern dating into something terrifying.

articles.title: Russian attacks kill six in Kyiv, other cities; expose gaps in Ukraine’s air defences
articles.summary: Moscow has in recent weeks stepped up its use of ballistic missiles as it seeks to choke off Ukrainian strikes on oil facilities deep inside Russia that have caused critical fuel shortages affecting both the military and the civilian population. Russian attacks kill six in Kyiv, other cities; expose gaps in Ukraine’s air defences.

articles.title: Central Asian Countries Face Fuel Shortages As Russian Oil Exports Drop Off
articles.summary: Russia is experiencing severe fuel shortages as a result of Ukrainian strikes on its energy infrastructure, resulting in high prices and long lines for gasoline. Now Central Asian countries, which rely heavily on imports of Russian petroleum products, are seeing similar price hikes and shortages. Central Asian Countries Face Fuel Shortages As Russian Oil Exports Drop Off.

articles.title: Hungary’s ruling party backs chess legend Judit Polgar for President
articles.summary: Prime Minister Peter Magyar said that he would ask Ms. Polgar, widely regarded as the ‌greatest ever female chess player, to take up the largely ceremonial role of President until ‌a new constitution is passed Hungary’s ruling party backs chess legend Judit Polgar for President.

articles.title: Russian And Ukraine Exchange Overnight Strikes As Drone Attacks Target Moscow Region
articles.summary: Large plumes of black smoke rose high into the skies of the Moscow region on July 20 after Ukrainian drone strikes hit an oil depot and logistics facilities, wounding 10 people as Kyiv vowed to respond to deadly Russian attacks that have left several people dead. Russian And Ukraine Exchange Overnight Strikes As Drone Attacks Target Moscow Region.

articles.title: Haiti endures violence and hunger, but hopes grow for a more secure future
articles.summary: After years of violence perpetrated by gangs, widespread insecurity and the displacement of almost 1.5 million people as well as growing humanitarian needs, Haitians are glimpsing signs of hope as a path to democratic elections begins to emerge. At UN Headquarters in New York, the 15-member Security Council discusses what next for Haiti. Full live coverage below. Haiti endures violence and hunger, but hopes grow for a more secure future.

articles.summary: The third India-Australia Annual Summit in Melbourne on July 9 produced outcomes across defense, energy, critical minerals, technology and education. 18 in all. But by far the most significant deliverable centered on Australian uranium exports to India. After nearly 12 years of a civil nuclear agreement on paper, Australia and India finalized the administrative [] The post Australia-India partne. articles.summary: America’s Asia-Pacific defense decentralization policy is rooted in a systemic crisis gripping its military-industrial complex. The breaking point has come to light amid its ongoing conflict with Iran, combined with a protracted maritime campaign against Houthi militants in the Red Sea. articles.summary: The war with Iran is driving fuel shortages and inflation around the world, deepening anti-American sentiment at a time when international confidence in the United States is already in decline. A June Pew survey found unfavorable views of the rising across 36 countries. articles.title: Middle East Countries On High Alert As US Continues Strikes On Iran
articles.summary: Air raid sirens blared in Bahrain and other Gulf states as the struggle for control of the Strait of Hormuz continued after US forces conducted a ninth day of air strikes on targets around Iran. Middle East Countries On High Alert As US Continues Strikes On Iran.

articles.title: A former Ferrari boss has a blunt message: Your commute is more dangerous than his old job
articles.summary: Jean Todt spent decades around the deadliest motorsport on Earth. He was a rally co‑driver, then ran Ferrari’s Formula One team, then became president of world motorsport’s governing body. In his early years, a driver dying at the track barely made news. A former Ferrari boss has a blunt message: Your commute is more dangerous than his old job.

articles.title: 'Sooner Or Later This Problem Will Be On Your Soil': Estonia Pushes Europe To Bar Russian Fighters
articles.summary: As Russia's war against Ukraine reshapes Europe's security landscape, Estonia is closely watching the Kremlin's next moves. In an interview with RFE/RL, Estonia's Undersecretary for Internal Security Joosep Kaasik discusses why Tallinn believes prevention is Europe's best defense. 'Sooner Or Later This Problem Will Be On Your Soil': Estonia Pushes Europe To Bar Russian Fighters.

articles.title: 'We Have To Be Realists' Regarding Threats From Russia
articles.summary: Joosep Kaasik, the undersecretary for internal security in Estonia's Ministry of the Interior, told RFE/RL in an interview that his country takes the threat of a potential Russian attack seriously, but is also prepared to deal with the use of soft power by its Eastern neighbor. 'We Have To Be Realists' Regarding Threats From Russia.

articles.title: ‘We are preserving a tradition’: how Ghana’s sensationalist film posters became collectible art
articles.summary: Hand-painted works are often wildly unfaithful to the movies they portray – reinterpretations that sometimes resulted in threats, insults and even physical attacks from viewers who felt dupedSitting on his porch in Teshie near Accra, Heavy J dipped a brush into red oil paint and dabbed it carefully on to his canvas – a flour sack – adding blood to a knife being wielded by a man.

articles.title: Australia updates travel advice for Laos as charges announced over mass methanol poisoning
articles.summary: Distillery owner could face only three months in jail over alleged poisoning of Australian teenagersGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastThe Australian government has increased its travel alert level for Laos, advising travellers to “exercise a high degree of caution” due to the risk of methanol poisoning. Australia updates travel advice for Laos as charges announced over mass methanol poisoning.

articles.title: Biodiversity fears as human-bred hybrid fish integrate into Philippines lake
articles.summary: Escaped flowerhorn cichlids are causing concern for native species and about parasites capable of infecting humansEscaped ornamental aquarium fish have integrated into a local ecosystem in the Philippines, but scientists say they may be threatening the native biodiversity of the lake. Flowerhorn cichlids – human-bred hybrid fish prized for their bright-gold colour and prominent head humps – are bel Biodiversity fears as human-bred hybrid fish integrate into Philippines lake.

articles.title: Thai prisoners brew a path back to daily life
articles.summary: It looks like a regular coffee shop, albeit set up in an old red bus. Stairs lead up to a serving hatch, with a menu of drink options. A selection of jaunty coffee-related messages like “My one and only love: Americano” and “Miss you a latte,” adorn the side of the bus. Thai prisoners brew a path back to daily life.

articles.title: UN chief calls for new diplomatic push following attacks on civilian areas
articles.summary: The UN Secretary-General remains deeply concerned by the continuing deadly military escalation between Iran and the United States, his spokesperson said on Friday as attacks destroyed key civilian and military infrastructure across the Gulf region. UN chief calls for new diplomatic push following attacks on civilian areas.

articles.title: Emergency alert spotlights sharp hunger spike
articles.summary: More than 256,000 people in Djibouti – around 25 per cent of the population – are likely to face crisis or emergency level hunger over the coming months, a UN-backed global food monitoring network warned in a new report released Friday. Emergency alert spotlights sharp hunger spike.

articles.title: Thunderstorms strike across Europe amid record heatwave
articles.summary: Storms are typical during intense heat but this week’s have been extreme. Plus, deadly monsoon rains in BangladeshHailstones the size of golf balls have been seen in French villages as, on top of the exceptional European heatwave, thunderstorms have struck across parts of Europe. Thunderstorms strike across Europe amid record heatwave.
